gh.connect_help: Make a personal access token on %{host} (Settings › Developer settings › Personal access tokens), then paste it here. A classic token needs the “repo” and “workflow” scopes. It is sent to %{host} only. If this server is not a GitHub, do not give it a token.
gh.err_branch_kept: Merged, but the branch was not deleted: %{why}
gh.err_https: The address must start with https://
gh.err_moved: The repository moved: update the address of the remote.
gh.err_store: No folder to keep the settings in.
gh.err_token: GitHub refuses the token: it is wrong or expired.
gh.mr_pushed_hint: Only branches pushed to GitHub are listed.
gh.mr_remove_source: Delete the source branch once merged
gh.no_project: No Git repository with a remote was found in the open project.
gh.pipeline_started: Workflow started: its run appears in a moment.
gh.settings_help: A token is asked for in the GitHub tab of the Git panel, for each server. It is kept in the keychain of the system (in a file only you can read when there is none).
gh.tag_needs: Give the tag a name and a branch or commit.
gh.title: Title
